Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Ιωνάς, Βαραχήσιος και οι συν αυτοίς …», with the rank word left off.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 29 martie — «Sfântul Mucenic Varahisie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Ιωνάς, Βαραχήσιος και οι συν αυτοίς Ζανιθάς, Λάζαρος, Μαρουθάς, Ναρσής, Ηλίας, Μάρης, Άβιβος, Σιμιάθης και Σάββας (ή Σώθα)»

attestations.note: The page dates the martyrdom «περίπου το 330 μ.Χ.» under Shapur and Constantine the Great, names the town, the three Persian magistrates and the Christian who bought the relics, and gives his own death in detail: dragged naked through thorns, thrown into a pit, and boiling pitch poured down his throat. It names all nine of the imprisoned martyrs and says their perfecting fell on 27 March and his own and Jonah's on 29 March. It prints no hymn; the two this folder already carries are the Romanian ones.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Iona şi Varahisie şi al celor împreună cu dânşii (the page prints «nesctricăciunii»)

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contending won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength they overthrew the tormentors, and broke also the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Luminaţi fiind de Harul Cel Adevărat, cu dreaptă credinţă îndreptaţi, în chip luminat, marginile pământului, sfinţiţilor şi măriţilor mucenici. Pentru aceasta, cu credinţă, vă fericim pe voi.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfinţilor Mucenici Iona şi Varahisie şi al celor împreună cu dânşii, «Arătatu-Te-ai astăzi...»

english.text: Enlightened by the true Grace, O consecrated and glorious martyrs, you set the ends of the earth aright in the true faith, and made them shine. Therefore we call you blessed in faith.

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι Ιωνάς και Βαραχήσιος ήταν ασκητές και μαρτύρησαν περίπου το 330 μ.Χ., όταν βασιλιάς των Περσών ήταν ο Σαβώριος και των Βυζαντινών ο Μέγας Κωνσταντίνος.» This folder held no `dates` before; the page's «περίπου», about, is why the display says about 330.
